_comment: ONE file, the same on every machine: copy to ~/.config/cortados/exec-hosts.json on the Pro, the Air and the Studio (scripts/install_exec_host.sh prints the entry for the machine it runs on). Each machine recognises its own entry by `hostnames` (short hostname, case-insensitive), so start_task's host "here" (or "local") means the machine whose cortados-route server got the call; a machine with no entry naming it refuses "here" instead of running elsewhere. `default` is where start_task runs without a host (owner decision 2026-11-08: the always-on Air). An entry with `ssh` can be reached from other machines and needs `router` (its cortados-router checkout); set `claude`, `path` (ssh sessions get a bare PATH) and `provider_url` (the token is read from ~/.config/cortados/provider-token ON THAT MACHINE). An entry without `ssh` (the Pro: nothing ssh-es into the laptop) runs only tasks started on that machine itself; from anywhere else it is refused. `gui: true` means chrome (login-mode) and connector children are launched as per-task LaunchAgents in that machine's desktop session; Chrome serves one client at a time per machine.
